第13章 林芜确实有吸引你的资本（第1页）
距离遥远，且封庭深背着光，容辞无法看清他脸上的神色。
封庭琳：“其实我能理解你。我见过林芜几次，听说她现在才25，就已经从世界top级大学拿到了博士学位，且家族的事业她似乎也能处理得很好，长得又漂亮，性子更是又野又难驯——她的优秀和耀眼，确实是绝大部分女人没有的，确实有吸引你的资本。可她出身不够光彩，庭深，你想清楚了吗？你——”
封庭深：“想要什么样的女人我自己清楚。”
“但是——”封庭琳皱眉，她虽看不上容辞，但也看不上林芜，她想说什么，可看到封庭深眼底的不悦，她也懒得说了：“这么护犊子，半句都说不得，我不说了还不行吗？”
容辞听着，攥着手，脸颊被夜风刷得生痛。
她苦涩一笑没了继续听下去的兴致，转身离开了。
她刚离开，封庭琳想起了一件事：“对了，听容辞说她递交了辞呈，准备离开公司了？”
封庭深：“前天下午，听程源说她做错了事，程源挺生气，我让他按公司程序走辞退她。”
封庭琳嗤笑了声：“原来如此。之前她说起这件事的时候，那语气好像是她自己辞职似的，我说呢……就她那粘皮膏一样粘着你的性子，她怎么可能舍得主动辞职，原来是被人辞退啊，哈哈～”
封庭深没接话，似乎这件事跟他没半分关系。
容辞上了二楼，准备回房时，和准备下楼的封庭漪差点撞上。
反应过来后，封庭漪率先道歉，并关心道：“嫂子，你没事吧？”
封庭漪是封家除了老太太之外，唯一对她态度不错的人。
容辞和封庭深结婚时，封庭漪还小，很多事都知道得不清楚。
认识这么多年，他一直觉得容辞漂亮又温柔，婚后更是从来都不会主动跟他哥吵闹，一直很包容他哥。
如果他以后的妻子是这个样子，他肯定会对她百般好。
正因如此，哪怕长大后弄清楚了来龙去脉，他依旧挺喜欢容辞的。

他见容辞似乎不太开心，想来也和他哥有关，他挠挠头，真诚的说道：“嫂子，你这么好，我哥他将来肯定能看见的，你不要太难过了。”
容辞顿了下，也不好跟他解释说他们快离婚的事，笑道：“嗯，谢谢你庭漪。”
“我下楼去喝点东西，时间不早了，嫂子你早点休息。”
回了房间，容辞关了房间大灯，打开床头的暗灯睡下。
她刚躺下一会，就听到了封庭深走进卧室的脚步声。
封庭深也看向了她，两人四目相对。
换了以前，她会主动起身帮他把脱下的西装挂好，然后开心的他找好睡衣，并进去浴室给他放洗澡水……
可现在，她没有下床的打算，而是缓缓闭上了眼睛。
封庭深虽然对容辞不上心，也对她平时对他的体贴照顾不屑一顾。

Chapter 13 Lin Wu does have the capital to attract you (page 1)
The distance was far away and the light was behind Feng Ting, so Rong Ci couldn't see the expression on his face clearly.
Feng Tinglin: "Actually, I can understand you. I have met Lin Wu several times and heard that she is only 25 now and has already obtained a doctorate from the world's top university. She also seems to be able to handle the family business very well. She is beautiful, and her temper is wild and untamable - her excellence and dazzlingness are indeed something that most women do not have, and she does have the capital to attract you. But her background is not glorious enough, Tingshen, have you thought about it clearly? You -"
Feng Tingshen: "I know exactly what kind of woman I want."
"But -" Feng Tinglin frowned. Although she didn't like Rong Ci, she also didn't like Lin Wu. She wanted to say something, but seeing the displeasure in Feng Ting's eyes, she didn't bother to say anything: "You are so protective of the calf, you can't even say a word, why don't I stop saying it?"
Rong Ci clenched his hands as he listened, his cheeks hurting from the night wind.
She smiled bitterly and lost interest in continuing to listen, turned around and left.
As soon as she left, Feng Tinglin remembered something: "By the way, I heard that Rong Ci said that she submitted her resignation and was ready to leave the company?"
Feng Tingshen: "The afternoon before yesterday, I heard Cheng Yuan say that she had done something wrong. Cheng Yuan was very angry. I asked him to fire her according to company procedures."
Feng Tinglin sneered: "I see. When she talked about this before, her tone seemed to be that she resigned on her own. Let me tell you... With her sticky skin sticking to your temper, how could she be willing to resign? It turns out she was fired, haha~"
Feng Tingshen didn't answer, as if this matter had nothing to do with him.
Rong Ci went up to the second floor and when he was about to go back to his room, he almost bumped into Feng Tingyi who was about to go downstairs.
After reacting, Feng Tingyi was the first to apologize and asked with concern: "Sister-in-law, are you okay?"
Feng Tingyi was the only person in the Feng family besides the old lady who had a good attitude towards her.
When Rong Ci and Feng Tingshen got married, Feng Tingyi was still young and didn't know many things clearly.
After knowing her for so many years, he always thought Rong Ci was beautiful and gentle. After marriage, he never took the initiative to quarrel with his brother and was always very tolerant of his brother.
If his future wife is like this, he will definitely be kind to her in every possible way.
Because of this, even when he grew up and figured out the whole story, he still liked Rong Ci.
He seemed unhappy when he saw Rong Ci. It probably had something to do with his brother. He scratched his head and said sincerely: "Sister-in-law, you are so kind. My brother will definitely see you in the future. Don't be too sad."
Rong Ci paused for a moment, not wanting to explain to him that they were about to divorce, so he smiled and said, "Well, thank you Tingyi."
"I'm going downstairs to have something to drink. It's getting late. Sister-in-law, you should go to bed early."
After returning to the room, Rong Ci turned off the headlight and turned on the dark light beside the bed to sleep.
She had just laid down for a while when she heard Feng Tingshen's footsteps walking into the bedroom.
Feng Tingshen also looked at her, and their eyes met.
Before, she would take the initiative to get up and help him hang up the suit he had taken off, then happily find his pajamas, and go into the bathroom to fill him with bath water...
But now, she had no intention of getting out of bed, but slowly closed her eyes.
Although Feng Tingshen didn't care about Rong Ci, he also dismissed her usual considerate care for him.
